notes: The ASV's 'those miserable men' renders both Κακούς and the object αὐτούς; 'those' assigned to the pronoun and 'miserable men' to the adjective headed on 'miserable'. Taking the whole phrase for Κακούς and leaving αὐτούς unrepresented is the competing reading.
s010's 'out' is the preverb ἐκ- under rule 106, headed on the verb word.
